title: GTA6 Monday Morning Mural Update Sparks Community Excitement
description: A recent Reddit r/GTA6 post highlights the Monday morning mural updates, with community members tracking the project manager's Instagram progress.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## Monday Morning Mural Update Captures GTA6 Community Attention

As the anticipation for Rockstar Games' upcoming title continues to build, the r/GTA6 Reddit community remains hyper-focused on any potential hints, art projects, or real-world updates related to the game. A recent post has once again drawn the community's eyes toward a mural project.

### Tracking the Progress via Instagram

According to a submission by Reddit user /u/Salty_Scrotum, followers of the Instagram account birntoutstudio have been getting regular updates regarding the painting process. As the user noted, the account holder appears to be serving as the project manager for the mural, making those posts a key point of interest for fans looking for fresh visuals.

### Will Jason and Lucia Appear?

In the same community post, the original submitter expressed excitement and speculation that we might see series protagonists Jason and Lucia featured on the mural by the end of the day. While this remains entirely speculative and is driven by community enthusiasm rather than official announcements, it highlights the creative ways fans attempt to follow any potential promotional art.

Readers should keep in mind that community-driven posts and Instagram updates of this nature are unconfirmed rumors and have not been acknowledged by Rockstar Games.

### Editor's Take

It is always fascinating to see how deeply engaged the GTA6 community is, turning every real-world mural painting into a detective mission. Whether Jason and Lucia ultimately appear on that wall or not, the collective enthusiasm on Reddit showcases the unmatched hype surrounding the game.
